title: Unify duplicated phone normalisation
prompt:
contacts.py has two near-identical phone normalisers used by different
code paths. Refactor so exactly one implementation, named normalize_phone,
does the work.

Requirements:
- normalize_phone(value) must exist and implement the existing behaviour exactly.
- normalize_home and normalize_work must keep their public names and signatures
  and must delegate to normalize_phone.
- format_contact must keep returning the same dict as before.
- Behaviour must not change for any input, including invalid ones.

Only contacts.py should change.
